world_type: 1-D periodic binary ring, odd N (149/599/999), fixed IC ensembles

pressure_type: none internal; fixed task fitness applied by external searches (Archaeon C3, Proteus mint)

at_T floor {0} for random tables gives no gradient
synchronisation has no solving positive control
